notes: Independent reading of scan 004 only. The whole image (1691 by 2361) and each supplied half were viewed once, in order. The upper half starts at y=0; the lower half starts at y=1100. Nineteen distinct tight crops were then inspected. All crop boxes and zero rotations are in crop_manifest.json.

Inputs read: the scan-specific brief, conventions, PREAMBLE, supplied notation snapshot, C.tex, H.tex, C_context.md, S.json, metadata.json, and the later authorized H drawing supplement for this same page. No OCR, recognition library, PDF text layer, web, other page, or other reader was used.
S.json is empty; there are no sweep statements to adjudicate. All seventeen C doubt loci are represented in findings, whether resolved or retained.

The handwritten page is headed Graphes. It defines graph incidence data, gives the two-endpoint condition, defines strict graphs, names oriented edges, and develops a topological realization through two-element-set segments. The bottom starts an unfinished discussion of rectilinear realization.

There is one graph drawing and one small boundary-attachment diagram. H’s supplied drawing was compared as an actual redraw: it is not counted as absent. The only dot discrepancy found is the blue upper junction dot. The detached smudge is preserved separately and has no graph interpretation imposed.

The author has no explicit prose doubt such as peut-être or a question mark on this page. Several crossed beginnings and an unfinished canceled quotient are present; they are retained rather than completed.

Page-state facts preserved: canceled title; canceled word before strict; canceled initial word before La donnée; canceled underlined Remarque; whole canceled quotient; canceled function with seg inserted above; canceled Réalisation; géom-like interlinear insertion; opening and closing brackets of the attachment note.

Slips retained: singular sommet after 2; connait without a visible circumflex; dans un vectoriel without an added espace. The final finite qualification has two visible points, while the later finie qualification has three.
H page 3 is treated as an editorial archive identifier, not a substantive collation difference. The lower-left archive 3 is a comment only. No cotefile macro is added because this is scan 004.

H style macros that merely differ in syntax or heading presentation are not counted. The boundary hook-arrow versus cap is counted because the actual visible sign changes; the inserted seg is counted for its above-line placement.
Several preferred readings remain linguistically awkward, particularly à 2 and Si a. Their plausible alternatives remain explicit. Mathematical or grammatical expectation did not decide the ink.
